blocks: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the Top 20 Female Toppers List along with the Re-NEET UG 2026 Results, highlighting the outstanding performance of women candidates in one of India's toughest entrance examinations.

Leading the list is Kudale Shravani Krishna from Maharashtra, who secured an impressive All India Rank (AIR) 5 with a 99.99965 percentile, making her the highest-ranked female candidate in Re-NEET UG 2026. The overall examination was jointly topped by Aryan Gupta (Punjab) and Panshul Bansal (Haryana) with 715 marks out of 720. More than 58% of the qualified candidates this year are women, underlining their strong representation among successful aspirants.
Top 20 Female Toppers in NEET UG 2026
Maharashtra Leads the Girls' Merit List
Kudale Shravani Krishna emerged as the highest-ranked female candidate in India by securing AIR 5. Her achievement also makes Maharashtra the home of the highest-ranked girl in Re-NEET UG 2026.
Bihar's Riya Ranjan followed closely with AIR 6, while Mansha Garg from Haryana completed the top three female performers with AIR 17.
